mainEntity.name: Is this an AI receptionist for HVAC companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Kaico Voice is an AI receptionist built for heating and air companies. It answers 24/7 with your company name, asks the questions you set, books the service call into your Google Calendar, transfers urgent calls to your cell and sends you a text or email summary after each call. It tells callers it is an AI, and you can hear it yourself at (918) 359-2644.

mainEntity.name: Does the HVAC after-hours answering service book jobs at night?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A call at 11 pm is booked the same way as a call at 11 am: the receptionist checks your Google Calendar and offers the first real opening, so the homeowner hangs up with a time instead of a voicemail. Calls that match your emergency rules, such as a gas smell or a suspected carbon monoxide problem, transfer to your cell instead.

mainEntity.name: Will callers know they are talking to an AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: It sounds natural, and it never pretends to be a human if someone asks directly. Most callers just want their problem handled: a clear answer, an appointment, a callback. The fastest way to judge it is to call (918) 359-2644 yourself. That number is the agent, answering live.

The agent does not handle real emergencies on its own. Calls like a gas smell, a suspected carbon monoxide problem, or no heat in dangerous cold with an infant or an elderly person in the home get transferred to a human immediately. You decide who that human is and how the escalation works.

mainEntity.name: Does it work with my scheduling software?

acceptedAnswer.text: The agent books appointments directly onto your Google Calendar. If your schedule lives inside field service software, tell us on the setup call and we will map out the cleanest handoff for your dispatcher before the agent takes a single live call.

mainEntity.name: What if it cannot answer a question?

acceptedAnswer.text: It does not guess, and it does not invent prices. If a caller asks something outside what you have approved, the agent takes a message for your team to return. You get a transcript of every call, so you can see exactly what was asked and follow up yourself.

Your receptionist is answering calls within 7 business days once we have your hours, services and call-forwarding details. Before that we learn your service area and the questions your customers actually ask, then test the agent with you before it ever answers a live call.

Month to month, with 30 days written notice to cancel. The phone is $299 a month on its own, plus a one-time $299 setup, or inside Front Door, Kaico's monthly service, from $900 a month. Build deposits are non-refundable once work begins; unused prepaid months are refunded.
